title: 2019-20 Panini Mosaic NBA Debut Silver Prizm #261 Jordan Poole (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019-20 Panini Mosaic NBA Debut Silver Prizm #261 Jordan Poole (RC) is a must-have for any basketball trading card collector. With a stunning design and high-quality materials, this card features Jordan Poole, a rookie player for the Golden State Warriors, in his debut season.

The card is part of the 2019-20 Panini Mosaic set and includes a silver prizm parallel/variety. It is a base set card and is perfect for anyone looking to add to their collection. This card is not autographed and is in great shape for display and preservation. Get your hands on this amazing card today!
